configurePresets.name: pitchnet-dev
configurePresets.description: Side-by-side dev plugin identity with ARA diagnostic logging. Optimized, so realtime behaviour in the DAW matches a release build, but symbols are kept so the VS debugger can attach to ARA callbacks. Logs to %APPDATA%/PitchNet/Logs/.

configurePresets.name: pitchnet-dev-debug
configurePresets.description: Unoptimized dev build with asserts live. Use only for stepping through logic that RelWithDebInfo optimizes away - realtime performance in a DAW is not representative and dropouts here are not real bugs.

configurePresets.name: pitchnet-release
configurePresets.description: Shipping identity, no diagnostics. This is the build that must keep resolving for projects saved against a released PitchNet.
